note: Discovery leads that have been looked at and should stop being reported. Google Books, HAL and Wikipedia are searched by author name, so they surface bibliography entries, name-checks and false positives alongside real citations, and — unlike the OpenAlex pass — a lead that is not a citation has nothing in the repository that could come to represent it. This file is that representation. Bibliographic leads that ARE citations do not belong here: record them in the citedBy array of the work they cite and they stop being reported on their own. Each key is printed next to its lead in the citation-watch issue, ready to paste; the value is why, for whoever reads this in two years. check-citations.mjs warns about entries that no longer match anything, so stale lines get noticed rather than accumulating.
